'''Shatter-missile launch tubes''' were a type of [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] mounted shatter-missile launch tubes on their [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]].<ref name="EGTD" />
